name: Loose puck
caption: A rimmed puck has died on the {side} half-wall in your zone, about 10 feet from you and from their center. Nobody has it yet.

questions.prompt: Nobody has it yet. What do you do?

options.text: Win the race: get there first, body between the puck and their center, chip it out along the wall if I am pressured.
options.feedback: Right. A loose puck in your own zone is a race, and you are closest. Get your body on the wall side so he cannot come through you, then make the safe play.

options.text: Let my D take it and get up to cover the point.
options.feedback: Your D is 20 feet away; their center is 10. Leave it and it is their puck in your zone with you out of the play.

options.text: Wait for the center to arrive and then go to the point.
options.feedback: Same problem. Nobody on your team is closer than you. Hesitate and it belongs to them.

options.text: Go get it and carry it through the middle.
options.feedback: Winning it is right. Carrying through the middle with their center on your back is where it goes wrong; the wall is the safe lane.
